profile.headline: Eng Tech Lead at Meta | ex AMZN, ADBE, MSFT
profile.summary: A technical leader experienced in shipping web, mobile, and desktop software. Strong focus on execution and getting things done, collaborating with UX and product management to create compelling user experiences, and helping teams see the big picture.

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description:
I was employee #3 at Qumulo, a successful scale-out storage startup with $130M in funding. I wore many hats over five years as the company grew to over 160 employees. I hired the UI and UX team, architected and implemented our storage appliance web UI, oversaw our REST API platform design and roadmap, co-developed Qumulo's engineering career path, mentored engineers, and created our Leadership Development Program for senior engineers.

Qumulo's web UI started in 2012 as a Backbone/jQuery/Bootstrap/ES5 single-page app, and evolved into a React/Redux/D3/ES2017 app with 1K+ Jasmine unit tests and various integration tests. The UI is a product differentiator, winning awards and new customers for its ease-of-use and real-time data visualization. I'm a co-inventor on two data visualization patents (filed, not yet issued).

I've blogged about UI and REST API development at Qumulo, including how we combined React and D3, and how we ship features incrementally every two weeks.

Technologies: Redux, React, D3, Jasmine, React Storybook, ES5/ES2017, Babel, Node.js, Backbone, Bootstrap, jQuery, RequireJS, webpack, HTML5, CSS3, Tornado.
Languages: JavaScript, Python, C

positions.title: Senior Computer Scientist II
positions.description: UI engineering lead for Adobe's first cloud-synced mobile photography app (Adobe Carousel, later Adobe Revel, now Adobe Lightroom Mobile). Designed and implemented the multithreaded rendering system, which integrated with the first mobile version of Adobe Camera Raw. Shipped the iOS and Mac apps, versions 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. Built a prototype for Windows 8. Demoed Carousel in front of a 5,000-person audience at Adobe Max. (Lua, C, Objective-C)

positions.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
I shipped these desktop products during my time at Microsoft:
• Microsoft Expression Web 4
• Windows Live Photo Gallery
• Windows Photo Gallery
• Digital Image Photo Library 11
• Visual Studio 2005
(C, C++, C#)

Received three Gold Star awards. Co-inventor on three patents (all issued).

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
As an engineer in Supply Chain Optimization Systems, I helped launch Amazon's first international businesses in Germany and England, Amazon's toy store, and Amazon's second data center. Each of these projects required significant rework of core supply chain code, changing assumptions about currencies and locales, SKUs, and execution location to support disaster recovery. (C, Perl, Java)

Hand-picked by Rick Dalzell, VP of Engineering, to be part of the very first "bar raiser" group. Interviewed over one hundred candidates. Responsible for ensuring that interview teams maintained a high bar for candidates.

patents.title: Analyzing and visualizing trends in the use and consumption of data in a shared storage system
patents.description: A facility comprising methods and systems for analyzing and visualizing trends in the usage of data within a shared storage filesystem is disclosed. The facility analyzes the rate at which the filesystem or a portion thereof is used by periodically generating manifests of the usage of the filesystem and comparing one manifest to another manifest. Furthermore, the facility may store additional information relevant to the manifest, such as the time at which the manifest was taken; for each directory, the sum of all of the values determined for items in that directory (including any subdirectories); and so on. In this manner, the facility collects and stores information relevant to developing trend information for each item in the filesystem. The trends analysis and visualizations described herein provide quick insight into the changes deemed most interesting or significant between two times.

patents.title: Filesystem capacity and performance metrics and visualizations
patents.description: A software and hardware facility persistently maintains metrics on directories at different levels within a tree of a filesystem. The facility hierarchically aggregates attributes of files contained by directories and stores them as metric values in each directory within a tree. The stored values represent summed or otherwise aggregated data from the descendant directories and files. The metric values represent aggregated attributes such as checksums, MIN and/or MAX aggregates, sameness bits, bloom filter aggregates, queryable user tags, moving average aggregates, b-tree aggregates, etc. The facility provides mechanisms for efficiently sampling activities performed by the filesystem and visually representing these activities.
